name: Shobai
overview: Shobai was a male member of the tribe of Levi, known primarily for his descendants who returned to Judah following the Babylonian captivity. His role is noted in the context of the post-exilic restoration as recorded in Ezra. There are no additional personal details or notes about him beyond this significant familial contribution.
namesAndTitles: The name Shobai may mean 'captive' or 'YHWH returns,' reflecting themes of captivity and restoration consistent with his descendants' return from exile. This proper name, found in Ezra 2:42, is not indicated as being given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Shobai is identified as a descendant of Levi, linking him to the priestly tribe. Scripture specifically records his sons as part of the group that returned to Judah, but no further family details are provided beyond this lineage and his progeny.
scriptureSignificance: Shobai's significance lies in his role as a Levitical ancestor whose descendants participated in the restoration of Judah after captivity. His mention in Ezra 2:42 highlights the continuity of the Levitical line and God's faithfulness in preserving His people through the exile. This connection underscores the importance of lineage and covenantal identity in the post-exilic community.
